proposal.reason: Main change is in network/proxy behavior: per-communicator NET/COLLNET backend selection/lifecycle, proxy progress batching and shutdown/abort handling, and larger NET request capacities. Additional review is needed for device-topology because intra-node NET-vs-P2P/SHM decisions now depend on topology bandwidth/affinity path modeling, and for transport because P2P/SHM/NET canConnect and connection-type routing were changed to enforce that new selection policy.
